name: MKT_IMP_OBJECT_ASSOC
description: This stores the association between the VOs and the columns that are linked for import objects meta data.

columns.name: OBJECT_ASSOC_ID
columns.description: Object Assoc Id : Primary key of this table.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: IMPORT_OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Reference to the Import Object Id

columns.name: ASSOC_NAME
columns.description: Name of the association between objects

columns.name: SRC_OBJECT_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Source Object Detail Id - Foreign Key to MKT_IMP_OBJECT_DETAILS

columns.name: SRC_OBJECT_ATTR_ID
columns.description: Source Object Attribute Id - Foreign Key to MKT_IMP_OBJECT_ATTRS

columns.name: TARGET_OBJECT_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Target Object Attribute Id - Foreign Key to MKT_IMP_OBJECT_DETAILS

columns.name: TARGET_OBJECT_ATTR_ID
columns.description: Target Object Attribute Id - Foreign Key to MKT_IMP_OBJECT_ATTRS
